title: fix(service-analytics): a preset dateRange on a date field counts the reference zone's calendar days, east of UTC too
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgKURKuRGF1ewEVVZKx7U1i4)_
Fixes #27172

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：报表的预设日期范围（如“本季度”）落在 `date` 类型字段上时，按参考时区的日历日计数；`datetime` 字段仍按时刻比较。两条查询策略、钻取范围、草稿预览共用同一处取界。
- 为什么改：东八区等 UTC 以东的租户，“本季度”会多算 6 月 30 日、漏掉 9 月 30 日，报表数字静默出错（西半球恰好正确）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响“预设范围 × 已声明为 date 的字段”；显式起止日期、datetime 字段、类型未知字段行为不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts`（新增 `dateRangeWindowBounds`，复用既有 `inclusiveCalendarDayWindow`）、`strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts` 与 `strategies/objectql-strategy.ts` 的预设分支、`drill-window.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/dataset-drill-window.test.ts`，预期 26 条全过，其中上海 date 字段 this_quarter 两条策略都只列 7/1–9/30 的记录。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A preset `dateRange` (`this_quarter`, `last_30_days`, …) resolves to the reference zone's midnight instants. On a `date` column those instants were compared as they are, and the column reads an instant by its leading UTC day (`temporalStorageForm`), so east of UTC the window slid one day early: in `Asia/Shanghai`, `this_quarter` counted 2026-06-30 and dropped 2026-09-30, on both strategies (measured red below). West of UTC the leading UTC day happens to be the zone's own day.

The triage rule (6465987107): a `date` field compares calendar days in the reference zone (ADR-0053), a `datetime` compares instants, and the executor's existing whole-day rule is used, not a new resolver.

- **The existing rule, reused.** `inclusiveCalendarDayWindow` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-executor.ts` already projects a lowered window onto the calendar days it covers in the reference zone (through `bucketDateKey`, the exact inverse of the `zonedDateStartToUtcMs` the preset resolver renders bounds with); `compareTo` shifts exactly that projection. No new resolver and no new calendar arithmetic.
- **One spelling for every face.** New `dateRangeWindowBounds(window, timezone, dateColumn)` beside it: a resolved preset on a `date` column becomes the inclusive day pair `{ $gte: first, $lte: last }`; on any other column it stays `{ $gte, $lt }` on the instants; an explicit `[a, b]` stays `{ $gte, $lte }` bound for bound. It is called by `NativeSQLStrategy` (compile), `ObjectQLStrategy` (execute and the SQL echo), `drillWindowBounds` (so drill and count stay on one lowering, as #27169 set up) and the draft preview's `evaluateAnalyticsQueryOverRows`.
- **Which column is `date`.** New `declaredDateColumn(ctx, target)` in `strategies/filter-normalizer.ts`, asked of the same `declaredFieldType` hook and the same storage target as `declaredDatetimeLowering`. A column whose type the host cannot name answers `false` and keeps the instants it was filtered by before.
- The `[gte, lt)` drill bound for a `date` window now reads `2026-07-01` .. `2026-10-01` in Shanghai, the same days the count uses.

Bounded in-place fix, declared: the draft preview face (`preview-evaluator.ts`, inside the claim's file surface) had the same defect, measured red on `4d3a077f` (Shanghai counted Jun 30 and dropped Sep 30); it takes the same helper, pinned by its own test.

## Tests

- `dataset-drill-window.test.ts`: the real-engine case "stage × this_quarter on the date field, Shanghai" now asserts the ids (`won: d2 d3 d6 d8`, `lost: d10 d4`) instead of parity only, on both strategies; added Los Angeles × `date` (west, unchanged days) and Los Angeles × `datetime` (instants: d2 out, d5 in), each also checking the drill lists exactly what the row counted. A unit case pins the engine bounds (`{ $gte: '2026-07-01', $lte: '2026-09-30' }`) and the drill range for Shanghai and Los Angeles.
- New `preview-preset-date-field.test.ts`: the draft preview on a `date` field selects Jul 1 through Sep 30 in Shanghai, Los Angeles and UTC; a `datetime` field keeps the zone's instants.

## Acceptance notes

- `driver-memory`'s cube face (`MemoryAnalyticsService`) is outside this claim's file surface and has the mirror-image defect: measured in-process on this branch, `this_quarter` on a `date` field (declared or not) answers Jul 1 and Sep 30 in Shanghai (right, by text-prefix ordering of a bare day against the instant) but Sep 30 and Oct 1 in Los Angeles (drops Jul 1, counts Oct 1). Reported to the seat for its own card; not touched here.
- An explicit `[a, b]` window keeps the engine's UTC calendar-day reading on a `datetime` column (ADR-0053 D-D), unchanged and still pinned.
- A field whose type the host cannot name keeps the instants (the drill already omits its window under a non-UTC zone).
